title: DMPF · Serviço (API, relay, consumer)
description: Um serviço por vez, separável por papel e instância: borda, caso de uso, saídas, consumo, pool de banco, resiliência, runtime e os logs OTLP correlacionados por trace_id.

panels.title: Borda HTTP: vazão por rota e status
panels.description: MET-09: _count de http.server.request.duration do otelhttp (só o BFF tem borda HTTP).

panels.title: Borda gRPC: vazão por método e status
Borda: latência p95 por rota e método
panels.description: MET-08: percentil 95 da borda HTTP e gRPC, em segundos.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Borda HTTP: tamanho do corpo p95

targets.expr: sum by (service_name, dmpf_operation, dmpf_outcome_category) (rate(dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Falha técnica por operação e categoria (eventos na janela)
panels.description: MET-10: só failed leva error.type; conta a série que nasce na janela. NotFound em FindReservation é o polling de convergência.

targets.expr: sum by (service_name, dmpf_operation, error_type) ((increase(dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation", dmpf_outcome_category="failed"}[$__rate_interval]) or dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation", dmpf_outcome_category="failed"} * 0) + ((dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation", dmpf_outcome_category="failed"} unless dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation", dmpf_outcome_category="failed"} offset $__rate_interval) or dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation", dmpf_outcome_category="failed"} * 0))

panels.title: Recusas e negações por operação (eventos na janela)
panels.description: DEC-04: recusa (rejected) e negação (denied) não são falha. Eventos na janela móvel, contando a série que nasce no meio dela.

targets.expr: sum by (dmpf_operation, dmpf_outcome_category) ((increase(dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation", dmpf_outcome_category=~"rejected|denied"}[$__rate_interval]) or dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation", dmpf_outcome_category=~"rejected|denied"} * 0) + ((dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation", dmpf_outcome_category=~"rejected|denied"} unless dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation", dmpf_outcome_category=~"rejected|denied"} offset $__rate_interval) or dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation", dmpf_outcome_category=~"rejected|denied"} * 0))

panels.title: Falha técnica na janela do painel
panels.description: Falhas sobre o total no intervalo escolhido, contando as séries que nasceram nele. Inclui o NotFound do polling de convergência.

targets.expr: sum ((increase(dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation", dmpf_outcome_category="failed"}[$__range]) or dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation", dmpf_outcome_category="failed"} * 0) + ((dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation", dmpf_outcome_category="failed"} unless dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation", dmpf_outcome_category="failed"} offset $__range) or dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation", dmpf_outcome_category="failed"} * 0)) / clamp_min(sum ((increase(dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation"}[$__range]) or dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation"} * 0) + ((dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation"} unless dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation"} offset $__range) or dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation"} * 0)), 1)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, dmpf_operation) (rate(dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, dmpf_operation) (rate(dmpf_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", dmpf_operation=~"$operation"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Retentativas (eventos na janela)
panels.description: MET-28: dmpf.dependency.retries por dependência e categoria, contando a série que nasce na janela.

targets.expr: sum by (dmpf_dependency, error_type) ((increase(dmpf_dependency_retries_total{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) or dmpf_dependency_retries_total{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance"} * 0) + ((dmpf_dependency_retries_total{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance"} unless dmpf_dependency_retries_total{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance"} offset $__rate_interval) or dmpf_dependency_retries_total{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance"} * 0))

panels.title: Recusas de admissão (eventos na janela)
panels.description: MET-12: por rota HTTP, método gRPC e tenant da allowlist (MET-07), contando a série que nasce na janela.

targets.expr: sum by (http_route, rpc_method, dmpf_tenant_id) ((increase(dmpf_admission_rejections_total{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) or dmpf_admission_rejections_total{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance"} * 0) + ((dmpf_admission_rejections_total{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance"} unless dmpf_admission_rejections_total{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance"} offset $__rate_interval) or dmpf_admission_rejections_total{service_name=~"$service", dmpf_process_role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance"} * 0))
